inputs.candidate: draft: record the immutable candidate source, resolved configuration, route, fallback, and behavior-affecting scope
inputs.baseline: draft: record the immutable baseline and comparable configuration, or a first-release rationale
inputs.contract: draft: link the versioned outcomes, prohibited outcomes, boundaries, stop conditions, and material risk record
inputs.approved_workspace: draft: record the approved isolated workspace root and allowed modification boundary
inputs.decision_owner: draft: record the accountable evaluation owner and external decision authority

outputs.coverage_map: evaluation/coverage-map.yaml — draft map of claims, risks, profiles, cases, levels, evaluators, stages, owners, decision roles, and rerun triggers
outputs.case_register: evaluation/cases.json — draft stable case IDs, versioned inputs, origins, tags, purposes, terminal outcomes, invariants, and allowed variation
outputs.fixture_manifest: evaluation/fixtures.json — draft fixture revisions, initialization, unique per-test copies, isolation, reset, reset verification, data handling, and authoritative observations
outputs.evaluator_records: evaluation/evaluators/ — draft claim-to-method, self-test, reviewer provenance, fitness, limits, and calibration records
outputs.trial_policy: evaluation/trial-policy.yaml — draft fresh-session, reset, attempt, retry, selection, fallback, status, resource, and uncertainty policy
outputs.decision_policy: evaluation/decision-policy.yaml — draft gates, coverage, slices, thresholds, missing-evidence treatment, repair rule, and authority
outputs.run_ledger: evaluation/runs/example-run/ledger.jsonl — draft append-only physical-attempt and final-policy result record
outputs.comparison_report: evaluation/reports/candidate-comparison.md and companion data — draft candidate-baseline pairing, flips, denominators, statuses, limits, and holdout disposition
outputs.repair_record: evaluation/repairs/ — draft location for any bounded, non-relaxing repair record; state no repair used when absent

assumptions: draft: the supplied candidate, baseline, contract, and configuration identities are stable until the retained artifacts are verified
draft: every execution will start in a fresh session with a unique fixture copy and verified reset
draft: only data authorized and proportionate to the stated claims will enter fixtures or retained artifacts
blockers: draft: replace this entry with each real missing contract, controlled fixture, authoritative observation, holdout, evaluator-fitness, workspace, or authority blocker; remove it only when no blocker remains

applicability.rationale: draft: the versioned claim-to-case, profile, cadence, owner, and decision-role map is not yet complete
draft: stable case identity, suite purpose, and independently authored holdout treatment are not yet evidenced
draft: fixture initialization, isolation, reset verification, and authoritative observation are not yet evidenced
draft: claim-fit unit, contract, integration, end-to-end, and adverse test-level selection is not yet evidenced
draft: attributable execution records and any applicable bounded repair record are not yet retained
draft: terminal outcomes, trajectory invariants, and their separate observations are not yet evidenced
draft: applicable adverse conditions, relation pairs, and repeated fresh-trial evidence are not yet complete
draft: applicable critical controls lack separate proposal, boundary, execution, and disclosure observations
draft: the harm screen and any triggered affected-slice evaluation are not yet recorded
draft: claim-sufficient provenance and visible evidence statuses are not yet retained for each result
draft: every decision-facing evaluator still needs its bounded claim-to-method record
draft: source, permission, state, and truth evidence types have not yet been matched to their claims
draft: decision-facing references, rubrics, reviewer provenance, and disagreement treatment are incomplete
draft: if a model judge is needed for a decision-facing claim, heldout independent calibration is not yet complete
draft: evaluator known-pass, known-failure, and material-change revalidation evidence is incomplete
draft: the proportional universal core, bounds, retained identities, and trial policy are incomplete
draft: independently triggered profiles and objective absent-trigger rationales are not yet mapped
draft: stage cadence, material-change impact, affected reruns, and regression intake are incomplete
draft: a guarded-live scope record is required only if live evaluation is proposed and has not been supplied
draft: candidate and baseline provenance, execution units, configuration, versions, and case-level records are incomplete
draft: comparable trial, metric, status, paired-flip, and uncertainty policy is incomplete where triggered
draft: the dated pre-result decision policy is not yet complete
draft: non-compensable gate application and invalid, inconclusive, failure, and repair dispositions are incomplete
draft: a decision record, limitations, next action, and downstream handoff are not yet justified by evidence
draft: any production-derived signal must be attributed, reviewed, sanitized, classified, and versioned before regression use
